segments.source: The victim in this case was a Mary Jemison, who, having severe pains in her chest, concluded that she was bewitched, and consulted the witch-doctors, who applied their extractive bandages, which greatly relieved her.
She saw a dog as an apparition coming toward her, and directed her friends to shoot it, but they did not succeed in killing it.
In like manner a cat, which was invisible to other people, was seen by her.
She finally recovered, but Andrew John, who was pronounced her bewitcher, and who was outwitched, is now dying from consumption.
